_about: Damage in the digital Lake (First1KGreek), found by collating it word by word against the Internet Archive OCR of his printed pages (vol. 1, 1919 printing: apostolicfathers01lake and TheApostolicFathersV1; vol. 2: apostolicfathers02lakeuoft, the 1917 printing; from 2026-11-13 also a Google-digitized scan of the first printing, 1913) on 2026-11-12, each read in context. Only readings where the digital text has a slip and the scan(s) the plain right form are listed; the collation is not exhaustive (it misses what the OCR copies misread alike). {book: {c:v: [[digital text, Lake’s form, evidence], ...]}}; tools/works-texts.py applies them after the elision marks are made one form and the colon is made the raised stop. "_app" holds slips in the apparatus (texts/src/<id>.app.json): {book: {"refs" or "notes": {at: [[digital text, Lake’s form, evidence], ...]}}}, applied to the margin reference or footnote standing at that verse; "move": {at: [[margin reference, the verse it stands beside on Lake’s page, evidence]]} for a reference the digital file puts in the wrong section.
